And who are you checking out? as the show is now Sold Out! 
 (I'm part of the Six Inch Screws) 
 Tribute nights have grown in perth, and whilst it's lovely to have these sell out shows, all these fantastic musicians likely come from local bands, so if you do see performances that are top notch be sure to check out their music too.
 Should be a killer night!
